title: Ride a sleigh through the National Elk Refuge
description: Climb aboard a horse-drawn sleigh near Jackson and travel onto the National Elk Refuge, where elk gather on their winter range. A guide explains the herd and the wider refuge as the horses carry you across open ground. Look beyond the elk too: the winter landscape can hold bighorn sheep, swans, and eagles.
teaser: Watch wintering elk from a horse-drawn sleigh.
goodToKnow: Sleigh rides depend on conditions. Ask about boarding, bumps and the cold before reserving.
whyItMightDelightYou: Being in the open air, at the herd’s pace, makes the encounter feel more immediate than a roadside stop.
